title: PHerc0826 spiral fits, z [8928, 9728): audit against the winding-model crossing stores
notes: Audits every attached fit (recipe, grad_mag variants, winding-model refits) with the same tools. First, for each fit, a block of 16 consecutive windings is scored as fitted and after tools/phase_align.py (crest mode: to the nearest crest of the CT, period 17 voxels) moves each winding onto the sheet it runs along: the model-free CT check (sheet_hits.py: is the CT brighter where the fit's windings cross a ray than half-way between them?), the gaps between consecutive windings (two windings on one sheet) and the share of the surface in voids (surface_void.py). Then: agreement with the winding model on rays not used for fitting (held-out store), the model-free check on radial rays from the umbilicus and on the store's rays (the model's own crossings are scored the same way), winding pitch, render contrast, and CT cross-sections with every winding drawn (full resolution at three places).
